block.title: Bloccato — rilevato un bersaglio non sicuro
block.body: L'anti-cheat o una sicurezza non verificata rifiuta sempre. Nessun controllo per continuare comunque.
cap.reshade.desc: Distribuisce ReShade (DLL proxy D3D/OpenGL o layer esplicito Vulkan).
cap.optiscaler.desc: Separato da ReShade; pianifica upscaler neurali locali. Distinto dal path tracing (tracciamento dei percorsi).
cap.remix.desc: Gestisce solo mod esistenti di path tracing (tracciamento dei percorsi) di RTX Remix; nessuna ricostruzione della scena.
cap.vkbasalt.desc: Pianifica i layer di post-processo Vulkan esistenti tramite env / opzioni di avvio Steam.
cap.goverlay.desc: Rileva la voce desktop e avvia Goverlay se installato.
cap.metalfx: Configurazione del layer di compatibilità MetalFX
cap.metalfx.desc: Configura MetalFX in un layer di compatibilità. Mai marchi di upscaler di terze parti.
cap.display.desc: Salva e coordina le preferenze dello schermo per ogni gioco.

hw.not_a_boost: These are host facts — not toggles buusdo can flip for free FPS. See docs/HARDWARE_NOTES.md.
hw.unified_memory.title: Unified memory
hw.unified_memory.body: On Apple Silicon / some APUs, CPU and GPU already share RAM by hardware design — not a buusdo trick.
hw.extra_gpu.title: Idle iGPU / second GPU
hw.extra_gpu.body: May help extra displays, encode, or per-game device pick when OS/driver/game allow — not a universal boost.
hw.resizable_bar.title: Resizable BAR / SAM
hw.resizable_bar.body: Can help the CPU address VRAM more efficiently when board/BIOS/driver/game cooperate — does not turn system RAM into VRAM.
hw.vram_spill.title: VRAM spill to system RAM
hw.vram_spill.body: Driver paging when VRAM is full is usually slower/stuttery — a fallback, not an optimization.
hw.soft_raster.title: CPU soft raster (e.g. llvmpipe)
hw.soft_raster.body: Can draw without a discrete GPU but is typically much slower — last-resort fallback only.
mobile.not_a_feature: Not a companion feature — desktop backends own installs; C1 still applies.
mobile.cap.status.title: Desktop status
mobile.cap.status.body: Read-only view of desktop online state, recent games, and short history.
mobile.cap.status.notes: Does not install or inject anything.
mobile.cap.scan.title: Request library scan
mobile.cap.scan.body: Ask the paired desktop to queue a Steam library scan.
mobile.cap.scan.notes: Scan runs on the desktop; the phone only requests it.
mobile.no_remote_inject.title: Remote inject / install
mobile.no_remote_inject.body: The phone cannot deploy ReShade or inject into PC games. Mutating work stays on the desktop.
mobile.no_phone_gpu.title: Phone GPU as PC accelerator
mobile.no_phone_gpu.body: Phone or tablet silicon does not become a remote GPU for PC frames.
mobile.no_bypass_anticheat.title: Bypass anti-cheat from mobile
mobile.no_bypass_anticheat.body: Companion cannot offer continue-anyway around anti-cheat (C1).
companion.title: Mobile companion
companion.intro: Pair a phone or tablet on your LAN. The companion is read-mostly: status and scan request only — no remote install or inject.
companion.no_cloud: No cloud relay in 1.1.0. Stop pairing anytime. Tokens stay on this machine.
companion.clear_confirm: Remove all paired companion devices from this machine?
companion.about_intro: Phone/tablet talks to this desktop over LAN after you start pairing. See docs/MOBILE.md.
companion.loopback_hint: Safer for local smoke. Uncheck to listen on the LAN.
companion.copy_url_idle: Start pairing first to copy the LAN URL.
companion.copy_code_idle: Start pairing first to copy the code.
